name: Initiative posture
plain_definition: Preference to advance a plan first or preserve resources to answer others.
commander_example: Develop the main plan on an open turn versus wait with responses.
required_evidence: E-PLAYER-PACE;E-PLAYER-THREAT;E-CECOS; future player comparison across calm, behind, and disrupted contexts
dependency_overlap: All C01 scenarios share DG_C01 and cannot stack. Initiative posture may vary by game context; systematic divergence requires later split or restriction before scoring authority.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Resource visibility
plain_definition: Preference for power visible on the battlefield or held in hand, mana, or other less visible zones.
commander_example: End a turn with useful permanents versus cards and mana held back.
does_not_mean: Deception, control, fairness, or actual threat.
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C08 and C11; visibility is not threat level.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Disruption response
plain_definition: Preference to protect an established position, reduce exposure, or recover after broad disruption.
commander_example: Prepare protection before a board wipe versus recovery afterward.
does_not_mean: Resilience, interaction density, or high power.
applicable_identity_families: all; White; Abzan; Bant; Boros; Lorehold
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C05/C06; commander protection is not commander dependence.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Advantage tempo
plain_definition: Preference for repeated small gains, cycles, or one concentrated payoff.
commander_example: Draw or build a little each turn versus save for one major sequence.
does_not_mean: Game length, ending mode, or power.
applicable_identity_families: all; Red; Izzet; Prismari; engine families
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C14; setup length and payoff rhythm differ.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Commander reliance
plain_definition: How much the deck should depend on its commander being available.
commander_example: Commander as centerpiece versus role-player while the 99 still functions.
dependency_overlap: Separate from C03 protection and C06 engine concentration.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Engine concentration
plain_definition: Preference for one central engine, replaceable pieces, or overlapping small engines.
commander_example: One permanent makes the plan work versus several interchangeable pieces.
does_not_mean: Consistency, tutoring, complexity, or commander reliance.
applicable_identity_families: all; Esper; Simic; Quandrix; Yore; Witch
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C05/C09; shares a dependency group.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Pressure channel
plain_definition: Preferred way to move the game toward an ending.
commander_example: Combat damage, narrowed resources, or an assembled noncombat engine.
does_not_mean: Power, morality, speed, or opponent enjoyment.
applicable_identity_families: all; Boros; Gruul; Naya; Mardu; Dune
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C04/C11; ending mode is not payoff rhythm or visibility.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Mana commitment and interaction window
plain_definition: Preference to commit mana on one's own turn or retain options during opponents' turns.
commander_example: Spend mana developing now versus leave it for a key opposing action.
does_not_mean: Personality, skill, interaction density, or Blue identity.
dependency_overlap: C01 and both C08 items share a cap when they describe one cadence.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Repeatability preference
plain_definition: Preference for familiar access to a central plan or greater game-to-game variance.
commander_example: Use redundancy to see the same plan often versus accept different routes.
does_not_mean: Tutor count, optimization, competence, or budget.
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C06; repeatability is not engine centrality.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Theme-efficiency tradeoff
plain_definition: Willingness to keep thematic expression when a more reliable role-player exists.
commander_example: Keep an on-theme card versus replace it with a more efficient equivalent.
does_not_mean: Low power, inexperience, budget, or aesthetic color preference.
dependency_overlap: A secondary deckbuilding layer; never sufficient for identity.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Threat posture
plain_definition: Preference to avoid early attention, adapt to attention, or embrace being the visible threat.
commander_example: Keep a low profile versus present a board the table must answer.
does_not_mean: Actual power, aggression, sociability, or willingness to win.
applicable_identity_families: all; Rakdos; Grixis; Naya; Dune; Glint
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C02; visible resources and accepted attention differ.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Resource sacrifice
plain_definition: Willingness to spend permanents, life, cards, or position as fuel for later advantage.
commander_example: Sacrifice a useful creature for cards versus preserve board presence.
does_not_mean: Recklessness, Black identity, graveyard strategy, or risk tolerance.
applicable_identity_families: all; Black; Golgari; Witherbloom; Sultai; Grixis
dependency_overlap: Separate voluntary conversion from disruption losses.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Public commitment
plain_definition: How much spoken table agreements should bind later choices.
commander_example: Keep stated deal terms versus make short or revisable commitments.
does_not_mean: Honesty, morality, sociability, or political skill.
applicable_identity_families: all; Azorius; Orzhov; Silverquill; Ink; Mardu
dependency_overlap: Table preference cannot independently place an identity.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Setup tolerance
plain_definition: How long a deck may develop before meaningfully affecting the table.
commander_example: Assemble for several turns versus require useful actions while setting up.
does_not_mean: Desired game length, power, patience, or skill.
dependency_overlap: Overlaps C04; setup duration is not payoff concentration.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.

name: Deck breadth and constraint
plain_definition: Preference for a narrow deckbuilding constraint or a broad combined toolset.
commander_example: One color or unusual restriction versus several color roles and answers.
does_not_mean: Colorless, Five-Color, theme, budget, or power by itself.
dependency_overlap: A boundary observation only; overlaps C09/C10.
scoring_boundary: Observation capture only; no weights or identity points.
